sheets.title: Item types on a phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The panel was a file browser: Installed and Marketplace tabs, an unlabelled +, a folded builtin/ directory. It is now a list of switches grouped by what the types are for, with a search field; the whole row is the switch.
sheets.before: tabs + `builtin/ 23` fold, no way to choose a type
sheets.after: one 58px switch row per type, measured, `0 of 18 on` in the head

sheets.title: Two types switched on — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Switching a type on downloads and installs it: nothing of it was in the app until then. The head counts what is on and the bell carries the progress.
sheets.after: Login and Wi-Fi network on, `2 of 18 on`

sheets.title: Item types on a desktop — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Same list at desktop width: the definition's own summary fits on a line beside each switch.

sheets.title: Two types switched on — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: On: the switch moves at once, shows busy while its pack arrives, and stays on after a reload from a sealed copy.
sheets.after: Login and Wi-Fi network on, `2 of 18 on`
